name: Fleet Agent Memory Reset
description: Wipe a fleet agent's memory (Firestore core memory + working MEMORY.md) to a clean slate. Prime-only; dry-run by default; structurally can never target the prime itself.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When an operator asks to reset, wipe, or clear a fleet agent's memory so it starts fresh — e.g. after testing/iteration left confusing residue in its memory.
